app.title: Lunar Window
app.subtitle: Lunar South Pole Landing Site Navigator
app.tagline: Pick a lunar south pole site and see when the Sun and Earth rise and set there, with the terrain checked against NASA data.

common.empty_no_precomputed: No precomputed data for this point

map.title: South Pole Polar Stereographic Map
map.description: Stereographic map centered on the lunar South Pole showing candidate sites and terrain.
map.live_summary: Selected site: {name}, Latitude {lat}, Longitude {lon}. LOLA sunlight: {sun}, Earth visibility: {earth}.

dome.title: Sky Dome
dome.description: Local horizontal dome projection showing Sun and Earth paths against terrain horizon.
dome.method_note: Visibility determined when body elevation exceeds terrain horizon elevation at that azimuth.
dome.live_summary: Epoch {time}: Sun is {sun_status} (elevation {sun_el}), Earth is {earth_status} (elevation {earth_el}). Next sunset in {sunset}, next earthset in {earthset}.

verify.title: Verification Panel
verify.description: Verification table comparing model outputs against external ephemeris and data products.
verify.l1a_note: L1(a) is an implementation consistency check, not an external truth validation.
verify.l1b_title: Terrain model vs LOLA average visibility maps
verify.map_values_title: LOLA map values read at sites (no terrain model in this build)

timeline.title: Timeline Bar
timeline.description: Upcoming visibility intervals for selected site.
timeline.live_summary: Timeline for {site} over {range}: Sun {sun_pct}%, Earth {earth_pct}%, Both {both_pct}%.

compare.title: 3-Site Comparison and Date Shift
compare.description: Compare illumination and visibility across 3 candidate sites with base date shift.
compare.rank_swapped: Rank changed: {count} pair(s) swapped compared to baseline.
compare.live_summary: Comparison with shift {shift} days. Top site: {top_site} (Sunlight {sun_pct}%).

footer.data_source_note: Data sources: NASA Horizons ephemerides, LOLA elevation and illumination products, LROC imagery.
